load.title: Load your city

problem.notForgeHammer: This doesn't look like a city exported from Forge Hammer. Export your city from Forge Hammer, then drop the file here.
problem.appNotRunning: The optimizer isn't responding. Close this window and start the app again.

unknown.title: Some buildings are unknown
unknown.intro: We don't know these buildings yet. Tell us their size and whether they need a road.
unknown.invalid: Sizes must be whole numbers from 1 to 20.
checks.unconnected: These buildings need a road but aren't connected. Is that intended?
checks.leave: Yes, leave them off the road
checks.chosenLeave: They will stay off the road.
checks.loose: These pieces will be linked back to their main building:
guide.export.title: How to export your city from Forge Hammer
guide.export.1: Open your city in Forge Hammer.
guide.export.2: Use its export or save button.
guide.export.3: Save the file somewhere you'll find it, like your Desktop.
guide.import.title: How to put your new layout in your city
guide.import.1: Open Forge Hammer and your city.
guide.import.2: Use its import or load button and pick the file you just saved.
guide.import.3: Check the result in your city, then confirm.
buildings.intro: Click a building on the map to remove it. Click it again to keep it.
buildings.removeAdded: Remove this building from the list
buildings.nothing: Nothing to change? Just press Next.
buildings.overflow: The added buildings don't fit: {n} squares too many.
buildings.cascade: Removing {main} also puts its linked pieces in storage.
buildings.previewError: We couldn't check the space for these changes. Try again in a moment.
buildings.catalogError: The building list couldn't be loaded. Try again in a moment.
buildings.searchHint: Type a building name to search.
run.title: How long should it search?
run.hint: A longer search usually finds fewer roads.
run.reduced: On this computer results may be a little worse; a longer search helps.
run.warn: This computer is on the small side: the search will be slower.
run.stop: Stop now and keep what's found
run.noneFound: No layout was found this time. Try a longer search, or remove a building in the previous step.
phase.fitting: Fitting buildings around the best roads
run.busy: An earlier search is still finishing. Try again in a moment.
run.lost: The connection to the optimizer was lost.
choose.intro: Pick the layout you like. The map shows it; compare it with your city on the right.
export.intro: Save your new layout as a file you can load back into Forge Hammer.
export.failed: The file could not be created.
export.warnings: {n} added building(s) have no Forge Hammer type and are not in the saved file.
resume.title: Continue where you left off
resume.failed: We couldn't reopen your last city. Please load your city file again.
close.title: A search is running
close.message: Closing now stops the search and loses what it found since the last saved step. Close anyway?
